name: antbot
description: 搬运蚁 - 内置浏览器的视频下载、字幕生成、剪辑与发布工作台

scripts.build:mac: npm run prepare:css && npm run prepare:icon:mac && npm run prepare:voicebox && rm -rf release/ && npx electron-builder --mac dir && V=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && xattr -cr release/mac-arm64/搬运蚁.app 2>/dev/null; codesign --force --deep --sign - release/mac-arm64/搬运蚁.app 2>/dev/null; rm -rf "/Users/chenxincheng/Desktop/my/Develop/Claude/AntBot/搬运蚁.app" "/Users/chenxincheng/Desktop/my/Develop/Claude/AntBot/搬运蚁-${V}-mac-arm64.app" && cp -R release/mac-arm64/搬运蚁.app "/Users/chenxincheng/Desktop/my/Develop/Claude/AntBot/搬运蚁-${V}-mac-arm64.app" && xattr -cr "/Users/chenxincheng/Desktop/my/Develop/Claude/AntBot/搬运蚁-${V}-mac-arm64.app" 2>/dev/null && codesign --force --deep --sign - "/Users/chenxincheng/Desktop/my/Develop/Claude/AntBot/搬运蚁-${V}-mac-arm64.app" 2>/dev/null && echo "产物: 搬运蚁-${V}-mac-arm64.app"
scripts.extract:mac: VOLUME=$(hdiutil attach release/搬运蚁-*-mac-arm64.dmg -nobrowse 2>&1 | grep '/Volumes' | awk -F'\t' '{print $NF}') && rsync -a "${VOLUME}/搬运蚁.app" /Users/chenxincheng/Desktop/my/Develop/Claude/AntBot/ && hdiutil detach "${VOLUME}" 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build:win: npm run prepare:css && npm run prepare:playwright:win && npm run prepare:voicebox && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:win:portable: npm run prepare:css && npm run prepare:playwright:win && npm run prepare:voicebox && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --config.win.artifactName='搬运蚁-${version}-win-${arch}-portable.${ext}'
scripts.build:win:arm64: npm run prepare:css && npm run prepare:voicebox && electron-builder --win nsis --arm64
scripts.build:linux: npm run prepare:css && npm run prepare:voicebox && electron-builder --linux AppImage
